name: TOC Generator
author: ZhiYu Team
description: Automatically parse headers within Markdown documents to construct a dynamic, clickable table of contents (TOC). Supports nested lists, customizable depth settings, and smooth anchor scrolling for enhanced long-form document navigation.

name: Link Preview
author: ZhiYu Team
description: Asynchronously parses remote URL metadata (Opengraph/Twitter Cards) to generate elegant, visual preview cards inline. Includes cover images, titles, descriptions, and site icons with secure cache management.

name: AI Translator
author: ZhiYu Team
description: Seamlessly leverages LLM capabilities to translate selected text or whole paragraphs inline. Supports tone adjustments, domain-specific terminology preservation, and multi-language targets with high contextual accuracy.

name: Markdown Beautifier
author: ZhiYu Team
description: An advanced linting and formatting utility to beautify raw Markdown. Resolves trailing spaces, fixes unequal list spacing, standardizes line breaks, and prettifies tables according to standard GFM styles automatically.

name: Word Counter
author: ZhiYu Team
description: Provides comprehensive real-time statistics of Markdown documents. Excludes frontmatter, code blocks, and markdown markups to output pure word counts, character lengths, paragraph counts, and estimated reading speeds.
